dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.macro_annuli_edge_geometry: The three most prominent 'O' shaped structures on the mid-lateral flank exhibit high-contrast, dark perimeters with sharp interior transitions to lighter centers; adjacent 'C' shaped structures show similar perimeter thickness but feature distinct gaps on their dorsal-facing arcs.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.high_intensity_blob_density: High spatial density of small, solid low-intensity pixel clusters concentrated on the dorsal-anterior region; these clusters lack internal gradients and transition to a lower density towards the posterior.
dorsal_lateral_high_contrast_texture_top.constellation_keypoints: Centroids of the three largest central annuli form a scalene triangle with the widest angle oriented posteriorly; a secondary grouping of four low-intensity blobs on the upper neck forms a near-trapezoidal geometric relationship.
